PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($proc\) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host "Backend stopped" } else { Write-Host "Not running" })
PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { Write-Host "Running on PID: $\($proc.OwningProcess\)" } else { Write-Host "Not running" })

PowerShell(taskkill /F /PID 16076 2>&1; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Write-Host "PID: $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { Write-Host "Free" })
